Name: Sorrowful Wail
Components: V, S, M ( A very tearful eyeball )
Description: You bellow out a sorrowful wail from the depths of your soul, it’s sound waves echoing with raw arcane energy that cling to anyone within your path. All hostile creatures within a 30-ft radius of you must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or suffer 4d4 psychic damage and 3 Sinking count, or half that damage and count on a success, rounded down.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d4, you inflict additional 1 Sinking count and this spell’s reach increases by 5-ft for each slot level above 2nd.
